verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an integrations catalog that 'syncs with hundreds of the tools' and claims '100+ integrations' for automated evidence collection. Some story categories are evidenced: cloud services, SSO/identity app detection, and Jira/ticketing sync. Custom Integrations via API/CSV cover tools without native connectors. Missing for 10: any evidence of read-only or least-privilege scopes, explicit coverage of HR, code hosting and MDM integrations, per-integration setup documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
